title: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX
PUNJAB URBAN
IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 24th April, 2002]
No. Legis. 13‑4/2002,
dated 24‑4‑2002.‑‑ The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab
Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment in section 4 of Act V of 1958

PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX
PUNJAB URBAN
IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 24th April, 2002]
No. Legis. 13-4/2002, dated
24-4-2002.-- The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 4 of
Act V of 1958.--In the said Act, in clause (g) of section 4 of the words
"twenty seven thousand" wherever occurring shall be substituted by
the words "forty-eight thousand and six hundred. "
